_cronsDisabled: Disabled 2026-09-07 per explicit request to stop automatic background AI generation (twice-weekly blog drafts, daily grant scans) from firing on a timer with no human trigger — both call Gemini and were draining quota unattended. AI generation now only runs from an explicit admin action (the '/admin/blog' Generate button -> POST /api/admin/blog/generate-ai, unaffected by this). The matching .github/workflows/scheduled-cron.yml schedule triggers were disabled the same way (workflow_dispatch kept for an admin to run one on demand). To re-enable both crons, move this array back into the top-level 'crons' key: [{ "path": "/api/cron/generate-blog", "schedule": "0 10 * * 1,3,5" }, { "path": "/api/cron/scan-grants", "schedule": "0 6 * * *" }]
